create_reference: Operator submits a Customer Organization, Contact or standalone Dispatch Location command through the application boundary.
Application validates required structural/descriptive fields without treating names/emails/addresses as relational identity.
A new opaque internal identity is allocated and the record is persisted through HLD-02.
Selectors/projections consume the new active record after commit.
contact_affiliation_change: Command identifies the existing Contact by immutable identity rather than descriptive equality.
Current affiliation and dependent operational context are loaded and revalidated.
The previous current affiliation is closed as history and the new zero-or-one affiliation relationship is established atomically.
The Contact identity is unchanged; existing historical operational records keep their recorded organization context.
Audit/history records the reviewed relationship change.
reference_candidate_match: Consumer supplies an explicitly scoped candidate key/input rather than an assumed identity.
HLD-03 applies the governed deterministic exact-key normalization/matching contract.
Zero candidates returns unresolved; one qualified candidate may be proposed; multiple candidates returns ambiguous.
Ambiguous or otherwise review-required results are returned to the caller without mutation.
Any eventual create/link/merge/reassignment uses a separate explicit command and audit boundary.
archive_reference: Operator requests archival of an active reference record.
Application queries registered active dependency validators across owning domains.
If archival would strand unfinished active work, the command returns blockers and performs no mutation.
Otherwise the record transitions to archived while identity/history remain queryable.
Archived record disappears from new-active selectors but remains available to historical projections.
reactivate_reference: Operator explicitly selects an archived record and requests reactivation.
Current uniqueness/compatibility/invariant checks are rerun rather than assuming prior eligibility still holds.
Reactivation commits as a new audited lifecycle action without erasing the archival period.
create_site_with_dispatch_location: HLD-09 Site creation command validates Customer/Site fields and possible physical duplicates.
The application coordinator requests creation of one dedicated Dispatch Location under HLD-03 rules.
Site and Dispatch Location identities plus their one-to-one dedicated relationship commit atomically through HLD-02/HLD-14 transaction rules.
The current effective Site address drives the linked Dispatch Location's current address projection while historical logistics operations retain their own immutable snapshots under HLD-08.
write_setting: Settings UI submits a typed setting command naming the semantic owner and setting contract.
Owning module validates meaning; HLD-03 routes through the shared settings registry.
HLD-02 validates/persists the named/versioned setting atomically.
A read of an absent setting uses code-defined default behavior without persisting that default until an explicit write.

query_rules: Default active selectors exclude archived records unless a workflow explicitly requests historical candidates.
Historical views resolve references by immutable identity and must not substitute the current name/affiliation for frozen operation-specific evidence where the owning domain stores a snapshot.
Ambiguity and unresolved state are data returned to the caller, not exceptional guesses hidden inside repositories.
